title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for December, 10th (AAPL, ADBE, BG, BIG, BOLD, DG, DTE, MTN, NPTN, QDEL)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Dec 10th, 2018 // No Comments
Research Analysts’ price target changes for Monday, December 10th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $210.00 price target by analysts at Sanford C. Bernstein. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Adobe (NASDAQ:ADBE) had its price target lowered by Citigroup Inc from $309.00 to $300.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Bunge (NYSE:BG) had its target price lowered by Citigroup Inc from $82.00 to $80.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Big Lots (NYSE:BIG) had its target price trimmed by Citigroup Inc from $51.00 to $36.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Audentes Therapeutics (NASDAQ:BOLD) had its price target cut by Citigroup Inc from $40.00 to $28.00. Citigroup Inc currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Dollar General (NYSE:DG) had its target price trimmed by Citigroup Inc from $133.00 to $120.00. They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
DTE Energy (NYSE:DTE) had its price target boosted by Citigroup Inc from $110.00 to $118.00. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Vail Resorts (NYSE:MTN) had its target price lowered by Barclays PLC from $290.00 to $280.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
NeoPhotonics (NYSE:NPTN) was given a $13.00 price target by analysts at Rosenblatt Securities. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Quidel (NASDAQ:QDEL) had its target price trimmed by Barclays PLC from $85.00 to $77.00. Barclays PLC currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
Ra Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RARX) was given a $34.00 target price by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Raymond James (NYSE:RJF) had its price target cut by Citigroup Inc from $86.00 to $85.00. They currently have a neutral rating on the stock.
Construction Partners (NASDAQ:ROAD) was given a $14.00 target price by analysts at Imperial Capital. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
